title: Energy vs AR vs Self-Consistency at matched compute (Kona premise v2)
task_name: GSM8K (original questions, exp281 corpus), held-out shuffled split
compute_parity_note: All conditions use the same base model unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE, ~3B active params, Q4_K_M) on the same 200 paired problems. Greedy AR = 1 greedy generation/problem (the matched-compute floor). Conditions 2-4 (self-consistency, self-certainty BoN, energy-argmin, energy-weighted vote) ALL consume the SAME 5 sampled generations/problem (temp 0.8); only the selection/aggregation differs — energy gets NO extra samples. The energy conditions add only a 16-dim latent gradient descent (8 steps, negligible FLOPs, no token sampling in-loop). The energy-weighted vote softmaxes over per-problem z-scored final energies at temperature T=0.5 (scale-free; T->inf recovers plain majority vote). PRIMARY comparison is energy_weighted_vote vs self_consistency at matched compute; delta_energy_vs_greedy_ar is reported only for continuity with exp3312.

field_provenance.self_consistency_accuracy: Majority vote over k samples — the PRIMARY control energy must beat.
field_provenance.self_certainty_bon_accuracy: Self-certainty Best-of-N (arXiv:2502.18581) — the strongest cheap selector.
field_provenance.energy_argmin_accuracy: Energy-argmin selection over the same k samples.
field_provenance.energy_weighted_vote_accuracy: Energy-weighted vote (EBM-CoT) — the premise under test; the headline condition.
field_provenance.delta_energy_vs_self_consistency: energy_weighted_vote minus self_consistency at MATCHED compute — THE headline; does energy add value over majority vote?
field_provenance.delta_energy_vs_greedy_ar: energy minus greedy AR — reported for continuity with exp3312.
field_provenance.paired_significance: McNemar exact p + paired bootstrap CI95 for the PRIMARY (energy vs SC) delta; an unpaired or n<200 delta is gameable.
